content: ‘BERT’ and BioBERT are very similar in terms of architecture. Difference is that ‘BERT’ is pretrained on Wikipedia articles, whereas BioBERT version used in our experiments is pretrained on Wikipedia, PMC and PubMed articles. Therefore BioBERT model is expected to perform well with biomedical text, in terms of generating contextual word embeddings.
